summary: Tested M2-S01 (access, built by metadata-builder). Ran the two declared checkers verbatim from the build directory at the plan's own build scope (custom-permissions and permission-set-architecture, both --manifest-dir artefacts), plus the always-on xml parse (3/3 files) and manifest consistency check (CustomPermission and PermissionSet each named explicitly in package.xml with a file behind each, both directions consistent, no coverage-gap exclusion applies to either type), plus check-outputs --hashes. All four runnable tests passed: both checkers exited 0, xml all-parse, manifest consistent, check-outputs ok with no missing/empty/malformed paths. The step's one manual acceptance test was checked against the Given/When/Then shape (all three clauses present, Then is a directly-inspectable file read) and deferred verbatim to the M2 milestone gate rather than ticked. results.json written with "passed": true and artefact_hashes from check-outputs --hashes; M2-S01 moved built -> tested via build_plan.py set-status.
confidence_rationale: Every declared test ran (or was correctly classified as manual), both always-on checks completed, and every result came from an exit code this agent observed directly (not inherited from the builder's envelope) — the Step 7 HIGH row in agents/step-tester/AGENT.md. No command test was refused, no manifest exclusion had to be applied, and check-outputs reported ok with nothing missing, empty or malformed.

process_observations.observation: Both declared checkers exited 0 when run verbatim at the plan's declared build scope (--manifest-dir artefacts), matching metadata-builder's own run exactly, including the permission-set-architecture checker's literal 'No issues found.' string.

package.xml names both CustomPermission and PermissionSet members explicitly (no wildcard) and both have a file behind them, so the manifest test passes cleanly in both directions with no coverage-gap exclusion needed for either type.

acceptance_tests[0]'s description narrates a fixture run ('1 info', 'Consumers 1') this run did not reproduce (0 info, Consumers 0). This is the same drift metadata-builder already recorded as O-M2S01-02; step-tester judged the test by its declared expected ('exit 0') and its declared command, not by the narrated fixture numbers, per this run's instructions and per AGENT.md's 'never rewrite a declared command' rule. Not treated as a test failure.

set-status's own full-plan validate pass printed 19 pre-existing WARNs about other steps (M1, M3, M4) shipping a cited skill's checker with no declared acceptance test for it. None of the 19 name M2-S01 or its cited skills (admin/custom-permissions, admin/permission-set-architecture, admin/validation-rules); they predate this run and are outside this invocation's one-step scope, so nothing was changed on their account.
